name: Virag 3D Studio
description: Rebuilt from scratch: 20 distinct production-grade 3D/CGI still-image presets with direct execution, strict source fidelity, anti-generic art direction and safe technical visualization.
executionRule: 3D STUDIO DIRECT EXECUTION — HIGHEST PRIORITY: create the FINAL standalone image now with the available image-generation capability. Never reply with a prompt, explanation, plan, storyboard or text-only concept. One preset = one finished image unless the user explicitly requests multiple outputs. Use ONLY the current request and current uploads as the active brief.
sourceLock: STRICT SOURCE LOCK: identify the current hero correctly — product/package, person/character, food/beverage, vehicle/object, place/interior, logo/brand asset or existing design. Preserve the visible identity-defining facts of that hero. Products: silhouette, proportions, package geometry, label placement, logo/artwork, colors and materials. People: recognizable identity, facial/body proportions, hair and distinguishing features. Existing designs: preserve all important content not explicitly requested to change. Never import an old topic, unrelated brand or unsupported claim.
renderStandard: 3D RENDER STANDARD: physically coherent perspective, focal length, scale, contact, gravity, shadows, reflections, material roughness, thickness, refraction, depth and motivated lighting. No melted geometry, warped logos, floating contact errors, fake reflections, generic smoke, random particles, repetitive cylinder podiums or one-style-fits-all CGI.
diversityRule: ANTI-REPETITION: every preset must create a visibly different spatial mechanism, camera logic, material system and composition. Do not reduce 3D Studio to recolors, podium swaps or the same centered product shot.
safetyRule: FACTUAL SAFETY: never invent prices, offers, ingredients, nutrition, certifications, medical/performance claims, hidden internals, mechanisms, technical components or scientific facts. Exploded/X-ray/mechanical modes may use only visible or explicitly supplied structure; environmental machinery must never be presented as real product internals.

commands.label: Cinematic 3D Hero
commands.desc: Premium advertising hero with strong scale and cinematic lighting
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Build one premium cinematic 3D advertising hero around the exact current subject. Choose the strongest camera angle for its real geometry, use deliberate hero scale, believable contact, premium material response, controlled depth, motivated key/fill/rim lighting and one memorable focal device. Avoid generic centered-on-cylinder composition.

commands.label: Immersive Product World
commands.desc: Custom CGI universe derived from current brand/category cues
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Build a custom immersive 3D world around the exact subject using only current visible brand/category cues. Create meaningful foreground, midground and background layers, category-relevant architecture/props/materials, atmospheric depth and believable scale references. The world must feel uniquely derived from the current subject, not a generic fantasy set.

commands.label: Anamorphic 3D Billboard
commands.desc: Single-view forced-perspective display illusion
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Create a convincing single-view anamorphic 3D billboard illusion with a clear screen/display boundary, controlled forced perspective, occlusion, cast/contact shadows and believable depth so the exact subject appears to cross beyond the display plane. Keep the result as finished campaign art, not a mockup tutorial.

commands.label: Chrome Sculpture World
commands.desc: Reflective sculptural campaign environment
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Surround the exact subject with a refined chrome sculptural system using disciplined specular highlights, realistic reflection sources, curved metallic forms and strong negative space. Chrome is the environmental language only; never recolor or metallize the locked subject unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Glass & Refraction World
commands.desc: Transparent refractive environment with optical depth
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Build a premium glass/refractive environment around the exact subject using realistic thickness, transparency, refraction, edge highlights, caustic-like light behavior and layered optical depth. Keep labels, faces, logos and locked geometry undistorted and readable.

commands.label: Liquid Sculpture
commands.desc: Controlled fluid-simulation campaign form
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Design one elegant liquid-sculpture gesture around the exact subject with believable viscosity, surface tension, splash shape, droplets, gravity, contact and lighting. Match fluid character to the current category only when visually supported. Keep the hero clear; no random explosive splash clutter.

commands.label: Exploded Component View
commands.desc: Source-safe separated-component visualization
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Create a clean commercial exploded view using only visible or explicitly supplied components. Separate known parts along a logical axis with precise spacing, alignment, original materials and technical-commercial lighting. If internal construction is unknown, show only known external/separable parts and never fabricate hidden components.

commands.label: Translucent X-Ray View
commands.desc: Source-safe shell transparency and structural visualization
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Create a sophisticated translucent/X-ray visual using only visible or explicitly supplied structure. Use shell transparency, edge definition, layered depth and controlled glow to reveal known structure without inventing electronics, ingredients, organs, mechanisms or unsupported internals.

commands.label: Macro Material Detail
commands.desc: Extreme close-up of one real visible detail
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Choose one real visible detail from the current subject — material junction, print, embossing, edge, cap, texture, fabric, food surface or craftsmanship feature — and build an intentional macro CGI composition around it. Use physically believable micro-surface response, depth of field and precision lighting while preserving geometry and branding.

commands.label: Zero-Gravity Composition
commands.desc: Dynamic floating spatial arrangement
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Suspend the exact subject in a believable zero-gravity spatial composition with carefully balanced orientation, spacing, perspective and supporting elements only when justified. Create movement through directional flow and depth, never through deformation, collisions or impossible product geometry.

commands.label: Surreal Scale Concept
commands.desc: One strong reality-bending campaign idea
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Build one clear surreal CGI concept around the exact subject by bending only ONE dominant rule: scale, gravity, architecture, environment or material behavior. Keep the subject source-accurate and make the visual metaphor immediately readable. Avoid unrelated fantasy clutter and multiple competing gimmicks.

commands.label: Monumental Architecture
commands.desc: Large-scale designed structure framing the subject
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Stage the exact subject inside monumental designed architecture with strong perspective, believable human/environment scale references where appropriate, premium surfaces, coherent structural logic and directional lighting. The architecture should frame or support the subject; do not turn the subject itself into a building unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Sculptural 3D Typography
commands.desc: Readable physical type integrated into the scene
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Use a short supplied headline or safe non-factual hook as real sculptural 3D typography with physical thickness, depth, contact, shadows, occlusion and material response. Integrate type spatially around the exact subject without covering critical product/face details and without inventing factual claims.

commands.label: Mechanical Campaign World
commands.desc: Precision-engineered machinery as environmental language
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Build a precision-engineered campaign environment around the exact subject using machined frames, rails, gears, pistons, clamps or modular structures as visual language. Keep joints, scale, shadows and materials believable. Treat machinery as environmental storytelling only unless the user explicitly supplied it as real product structure.

commands.label: Volumetric Energy Field
commands.desc: Controlled light, trails and particle flow
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Create a controlled volumetric energy system around the exact subject using light trails, arcs, particles or pressure-wave forms with a clear flow direction, depth and interaction with scene lighting. Treat energy strictly as a visual metaphor; never imply unsupported scientific or performance claims.

commands.label: Sculptural Exhibition Display
commands.desc: Custom category-specific product display
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Design a custom sculptural exhibition/display system for the exact subject with category-specific form language, strong material contrast, believable contact, intentional backdrop and refined commercial lighting. Avoid generic cylinders, default plinth templates and empty showroom clichés.

commands.label: Dimensional Portal Reveal
commands.desc: Subject revealed through a physical opening between spaces
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Reveal or frame the exact subject through a designed dimensional opening with real thickness, coherent perspective, occlusion, contact, light spill, atmosphere and clear spatial separation between the two environments. Deliver one finished still, not a storyboard or sequence.

commands.label: Inflatable Sculpture World
commands.desc: Soft pressure-driven environmental forms
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Build a sophisticated inflatable environment around the exact subject using soft volumetric forms, believable seams, pressure/tension behavior, soft reflections and controlled contact. Preserve rigid products/objects as rigid unless their real material is soft; never puff or deform locked packaging or identity.

commands.label: Material Terrain World
commands.desc: Cinematic landscape from one supported visual material cue
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Build a cinematic terrain from one visible material/category cue supported by the current reference. Use believable surface scale, erosion/texture logic, atmospheric perspective, depth and integrated subject placement. Do not infer ingredients, substances or factual product claims that were not supplied.

commands.label: Minimal CGI Sculpture
commands.desc: One precise sculptural idea with strong negative space
commands.prompt: Generate the final image now. Create a minimal premium CGI composition using the exact subject plus ONE strong sculptural idea. Use restrained materials, precise lighting, controlled shadows, clean geometry and sophisticated negative space. Remove all unnecessary props/effects and avoid generic podium-template aesthetics.
